### Loop 4 — 2026-10-09 · H1/H2
- **D-H1a — preview server is allow-list only.** scripts/workspace_server.py serves: `/` (generated homepage), gabriel_homes/{templates,static,docs}/ (browsable), gabriel_homes/{DEPLOY.md, DESIGN.md, WORK.md, requirements.txt, README*}, scripts/preview_site/{index,plan,checklist,qa}.html. Everything else → 403. A hard deny-list (any dot-file component, .env*, *.sqlite3, *.db, *.log, *.pyc, cookies.txt, __pycache__, download/, upload/, node_modules/, media/) runs independently of the allow-list so future allow-list edits can never leak those paths. Rationale: this server fronts a public preview link; earlier ad-hoc servers either showed only preview_site or had no principled boundary at all.
- **D-H1b — scripts/ reachable only for the four preview pages + assets.** The four HTML pages are the owner-facing purpose of the server; the rest of scripts/ is agent tooling (code, logs, cookies, scratch dirs) with real leak value and no preview value. scripts/preview_site/qa-shots/*.png is served ONLY because qa.html embeds it (the QA page renders broken otherwise); the qa-shots folder itself stays unlistable (403). Enforced in code, not config.
- **D-H2 — two export zips, two policies.** (1) gabriel-homes-oneclick.zip (customer deliverable) intentionally ships the seeded demo db.sqlite3 so the first run skips seeding; it now EXCLUDES .git/ and real .env (rsync previously leaked the whole repo history) and asserts .env.example/.gitignore/docs in staging and inside the finished archive. (2) gabriel-workspace-snapshot.zip (owner workspace export) must contain gabriel_homes/.env.example, .gitignore, docs/STATUS.md, docs/AGENT-BRIEF.md, manage.py and must NEVER contain db.sqlite3, download/, upload/, scripts/server.log — scripts/check_export.sh exits 1 and names each violation. unzip -Z1 (zipinfo names mode) is used instead of parsing unzip -l columns: same tool, exact filenames, no whitespace parsing.

### Loop 5 — 2026-10-09 · H3/H4/H6
- **D-H3 · pytest-cov==7.1.0 pinned as a dev/test dependency.** The G-COV gate stage needs pytest-cov; it previously existed only in the agent's venv, so a fresh environment failed the gate at `coverage` (reproduced RED in /tmp/h3venv via gate.sh's PYTHON switch). It belongs in the "Dev / test only" block: gunicorn/prod never imports it, pytest is already there. 7.1.0 is the PyPI latest and verified compatible with pytest==9.0.3 (fresh-venv gate GREEN after the pin).
- **D-H4 · snapshot builder interface.** build_workspace_snapshot.sh now takes WS_ROOT from the environment (default = the directory two levels above the script itself — portable, no /home hard-coding) and the output path as argument 1 (default $WS_ROOT/download/gabriel-workspace-snapshot.zip). The reported file count is read back from the finished zip (zipfile namelist), never from a walk pre-count — the pre-count could print "0 files" while the zip was fine. Regression-covered by scripts/tests_build_snapshot.sh (fake workspace, planted leaks, H4MARKER.txt to prove WS_ROOT is honored).
- **D-H6 · placeholder rule for the DEPLOY.md doc-lint.** scripts/tests_deploy_doc.py enumerates every angle-bracket placeholder it finds (<REPO_URL>, <generated-50+-char-key>, <release-tag>, <repo-url>) as "ALLOWED PLACEHOLDERS" on every run. Placeholders neither satisfy a check silently nor get auto-replaced by the agent; they stay visible until Brian fills them. The test parses `manage.py help --commands` as ground truth for command names, env-var assignments/shell refs vs .env.example, and verifies scripts/*.sh|py references exist (including "$SRC/scripts/..." forms).
